reviews.comment: didn't really teach all that well, she just read off of her slidshow

This was a difficult course, although it definitely helped to understand meteorology better. You are given 2 options for the semester, a quiz every week or quizzes plus exams. Every section so far has chosen a quiz every week and it is just terribly difficult. Also, EB is too strict, with the amount of time to learn new topics, it is just too hard.

For a 100 level class, the amount of information presented is extreme. She flies through PowerPoints with several dozen slides per class, and there is zero time to take any substantial notes. Several very difficult homeworks and quizzes, but she does drop your two lowest quiz grades at the end of the semester. She has some extreme testing policies.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice professor, but very test and lecture heavy

The majority of students taking this class are aviation majors, yet the class does very little to make the connection between what is being taught and the aviation field. Get ready to be talked to like a child. Her anti-cheating measures are way over the top. This class will annoy you. Weekly quizzes and labs aren't great.

I'm an AVIT major and I have mad respect for Dr EB. She really knows her stuff. It's also very clear she's passionate about what she teaches. Actually is available to students and wants them to succeed. AVIT kids with egos didn't like getting checked when they came for her and she knew more (duh), which I enjoyed witnessing. Effort = Success here.

I just finished ATSC 110 with Dr. Etten-Bohm and was very happy with her ability to present lecture information and availability outside of class. Overall I would recommend Dr. Etten-Bohm, she is educated, helpful, and very informative if you go to her office hours.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr EB is very passionate about the weather. if you are a meteorology major you will probably love her. As an aviation major i did not enjoy the course. The lectures have a lot of info for an introductory course and i struggled w quizzes bc of all the info. 100+ slides in some lectures with no information on what will actually be on the quiz.

Dr. EB is truly amazing. She so kind and caring and is accessible outside of class via email/office hours. A lot of people seem to complain about this class but then sit on their phones during class and are not willing to put in the bare minimum. Just show up to class, pay attention, do the homework, attend lab, and you'll be fine.

It's been summarized here already well. Flies through lectures, then tests you on things barely mentioned or written anywhere. Be prepared to study for weekly quizzes over singular lectures with 50+ slides of dense information in 30 minutes. Be prepared to be quizzed on things mentioned in passing or in lab. Not a particularly easy A.

She talks incredible fast through her slideshows in lecture. She goes through 100+ slides in 50 minutes, barely leaving any time to take substantial notes. She has no empathy for students who come up to talk to her after class. Not very helpful if fixing her own errors.

You will love her or hate her. She spends the first half of class every day talking about current weather without covering any relevant learning topics. She had weekly quizzes without any final which is the single reason I rate her a 3 instead of a 1. Her class is just incredibly boring and long winded.

I am disheartened to witness Dr. EB make an unfounded, baseless accusation of cheating to a classmate.  She is quick and eager to assume academic dishonesty without any legitimate or logical justification, and more than willing to make you suffer the consequences.  That should tell you all you need to know about her personality...

She comes across as nice, but if you email her you will probably get an extremely rude/passive-aggressive response. All she does is read off the slides, so lecture doesn't help with anything. Also, the first few quizzes were easy, but halfway into the semester she started asking some crazy questions that she does not teach you. stay away.

I was in the first batch of EB's in-person students at UND. She openly took constructive criticism about her class and really cares for her students. She would love to get to know you personally and is really sweet. Her lectures are typically awesome but I admit can be confusing at times. If you don't show up to class, you'll have a hard time.

Quizzes are often not related to the HW/PowerPoint/Kahoots and are at a level best suited for actual majors. Quiz bonus questions can be completely irrelevant to the course and involve the personal life of the teacher as told through the lecture. Lab will be difficult if you do not get a TA that is willing to teach you the material.

Dr. EB is a wonderful professor who really knows what she is talking about and wants her students to learn. The class itself can be hard and frustrating since it doesn't follow a flow for any aviation students besides atmospheric science so its all new information. Go to her office hours it helps a lot if you spend an hour there you will get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great class, EB will be back to you within a couple hours if you have questions. Class is 60% quizzes so that's rough, lab has been easy. It's not a "left wing" class, climate change is just mentioned as a factor for global temp fluctuation. I would expect to do some reading on your own, lectures can be hard to sit through. Overall I love EB
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. EB's class was a great one. I had no issues with her as a professor at all. If you show up to class and pay attention to the lecture you should have no problems. Labs can be difficult but fun, so make sure to take the lab with people you know. Overall, the class has some work to it but the material covered is not very difficult.

Overall she is a nice professor that is available outside of class. With that, if you are Avit, you will be irritated by her class. It's not directed toward a pilots view at all, test/quizzes are very difficult, lecture heavy, lecture homework is light but lab will have you pulling your hair out. Overall.. NOT.. a sit in class easy A grade at all.
Fantastic Prof. Super understanding and the coursework was super light. Just show up for class and pay attention, you'll be just fine.

- Tests/quizzes are worded difficult and unpredictable
- Terrible lectures
- Quiz prep is nothing like the test!!!!!
- Quiz questions are on her comments about lecture slides
- It's impossible to cheat (trust me)
- Must show up
- Test heavy
- Very left wing
- Lab is awful with awful T.A's
- Lab + Lecture = ++H.W
- Thinks her class > your major

Lectures are boring and can be difficult to pay attention too. Pay attention and write down on a copy of her slides things she mentions that are not on the slides and you'll be fine. Very left wing politically biased lectures, just say what she wants to hear and you'll get top scores. Very disorganized at first but listened to student feedback.

Professor EB is a very kind, passionate professor. She seems to love her work and makes herself available if you need help. If you somewhat pay attention in class, do the short weekly homework, and look over the slides she gives you, you will be just fine. Easy A class honestly.
Really great class! East A if you show up do they one homework assignment a week and she drops 4 of your lowest quiz scores. She also really cares about her class and wants to see you succeed.

Great professor, can't recommend enough! Took the online 7-week version. Her class had a decent amount of work but it was all very doable for the time constraints. Very lenient grader, 3 exams, no final or midterm. 6 lab quizzes but she drops your worst one and only one group project. Very fast responder and cares so much about her students.

The workload for her classes are heavy but the lectures are interesting and she explains concepts very well. She's very accommodating on turning in late work if you have a legitimate problem. If you take her class expect to learn a lot but also expect to take LOTS of notes and spend a lot of your time watching lectures.

I had an extremely difficult time coming back from covid and made a 23 on the first exam. She dropped that exam on the condition that I show improvement throughout the rest of the semester. That was a very kind and merciful thing to do and I recommend taking this professor no matter what. Her lectures are amazing and she's VERY accessible. Take her

TAKE HER! She's amazing. Lectures are interesting, she gives out tons of extra credit, open note exams, multiple chances on homework, partial credit on MULTIPLE CHOICE, etc.. This is such an easy class to pass, it's ridiculous. Those who rated her poorly likely put no effort into it. Just watch the lectures at 2x speed and take notes, you're golden

Montana is such an awesome prof! Great lectures with weekly homework. A couple of group projects. Quizzes every couple of weeks, and three open-note exams. Her study guides are so helpful! Lots of extra credit. She is very easy to get in touch with and get help from! Study and do the work and you can make a good grade. TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I don't understand how this professor is rated so low, SHE IS AMAZING. She cares about her students and gives plenty of info to do well throughout the class. She also gives tons of extra credit which makes it hard to do bad in this course. TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. If you do the work and follow along there is no reason to not pass or even get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: ATMO is SUPPOSED to be the class that everyone knows is easy. Counselors, students, etc. recommend this to be the easy science credit. This professor just makes it unnecessarily difficult. You will spend more time in this elective class than in your engineering and math courses. If you can avoid taking this professor, stay far, far away.

PLEASE don't take this course with this professor. Absolutely NOTHING that's on her study guide will be on the quiz/test that follows with it, and to make things worse, even quizzes are PROCTORED. If you try to ask her a question she'll just tell you to watch her Q&A session. She's super harsh at grading also, and leaves bad feedback. Run from her.

If you are not required to take this class, dont take it. This class has more involvement/work than my required major courses. I would not recommend it to anyone that is looking to fill elective or life/physical science credit. You can find an easier class. Her notes are fill in the blank and the lectures are extremely long and sub par.
